channel.title: Bryan County News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bryan County News (bryancountynews.com)

item.title: Wildcats top Tift County, 79-64, to keep momentum in region race
item.description: Richmond Hill head boys’ basketball coach Bill Henderson has been pleased with how his team has dealt with bouts of adversity throughout the season.

item.title: Preview: Lady Wildcats to face off against Lowndes for last regular-season game
item.description: Heading into the season with the loss of three senior starters, Richmond Hill head coach Sarah Jones knew it would likely be a different year ahead.

item.title: Bryan County High School celebrates two legendary former coaches
item.description: There’s a lot going on in athletics at Bryan County High School, what with the basketball teams getting ready for region tournament play and spring sports getting underway highlighted by baseball’s Tuesday night opener against Jenkins.

item.title: Redskins revive playoff hopes with 77-63 win over Claxton
item.description: Heading into the Christmas break and coming off a disheartening 74-57 loss at South Effingham there was no reason to think Bryan County’s boys’ basketball team had a scintilla of a chance of repeating last year’s run to the Elite Eight.

item.title: Bryan County girls wrap up regular season, look ahead to region play
item.description: With Bryan County’s girls' basketball regular season now over, next up is the Region 3A-DII tournament next week at Metter.

item.title: Richmond Hill basketball teams lose to Lowndes
item.description: For both Richmond Hill basketball teams, it was a long nearly three-hour ride to and from Lowndes High School in more ways than one Tuesday night.

item.title: Cox covers Wildcats baseball: Monday, Feb. 9
item.description: Mon, Feb 9: The Wildcats made the hour and a half ride down Highway 84 west to Jesup and took on the always-tough Wayne County Yellow Jackets. RHHS starter, Noah Stone, pounded his chest, pitching 6 strong innings, striking out 11, and only walking 2.

item.title: Redskins open baseball season with strong win over Jenkins
item.description: If he had programmed it on a computer Coach Kyle Farmer couldn’t have asked for a better night to debut his second Bryan County baseball team.

item.title: Bryan County Development ends negotiations with Westwin Elements. What’s next?
item.description: RICHMOND HILL – The Development Authority Board of Bryan County voted Tuesday to end all negotiations with Oklahoma-based Westwin Elements over its proposed nickel refinery in Richmond Hill.

item.title: Concerns over Westwin carry over to February County Commission meeting
item.description: Westwin Elements continued to be a trending topic of discussion at February’s Board of Commissioners meeting on Tuesday evening.
